The '''Londori sector'''<ref name="EAOC" /> was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Ariarch sector/Legends|Ariarch sector]] northward, the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] eastward, the [[Chaama sector/Legends|Chaama sector]] southward, and the [[Belshar sector/Legends|Belshar sector]] westward.<ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> The Londori [[Sector/Legends|sector]] retained these borders by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], when it fell within the territory controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

The sector contained the [[Londor system/Legends|Londor system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the adjacent Ariarch, Glythe, and Chaama sectors.<ref name="EGtW" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the site of the [[Londori Mental Facility]].<ref name="Creatures">{{WEGCite|book=Creatures of the Galaxy|story=The One That Didn't Get Away...}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Londori Mental Facility]]|system=Londor [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Londor sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The first update to the Online Companion erroneously listed the Londor system as being located in the [[Dantus sector/Legends|"Gantus" sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOCupdate1">See [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion/Update001|this preserved version]] of the first update of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].</ref> a misspelling of the Outer Rim's Dantus sector. Later updates of the Online Companion corrected this error. In addition, the Online Companion situated the sector in grid squares J-6 and J-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
